description: This file defines pin configuration and bias register mappings for Renesas R-Car Gen 3 hardware, including drive and bias settings for various pins and peripherals.

methods.name: pfc_rcar_get_bias_regs
methods.description: Returns the array of bias register configurations for the hardware.

methods.name: pfc_rcar_get_drive_regs
methods.description: Returns the array of drive register configurations for the hardware.

methods.name: pfc_rcar_get_reg_index
methods.description: Provides the register index for a given pin; always returns 0 for Gen 3.
